newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill drops to 5.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill drops to 5.47 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills dropped to 5.47 percent from 5.49 percent last week when the bills were for 90 days, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price of the bills fell to 98.637 from 98.645 and the minimum price accepted was 98.636.
Banks submitted bids for 26.15 million dinars worth of bills, down from 30.4 million dinars last week.
The bills are offered on Monday and issued on Wednesday.
